name: Simon Property Group
honesty: CLEAN — the one available masking channel (Catalyst/JCPenney/SPARC platform volatility) is QUARANTINED by SPG itself into the RE-FFO metric it guides on; Q4-25 disclosed the -$0.31 restructuring loss line-by-line. No takeaway-vs-data divergence. Correct no-fire.
quality: genuinely elite: A/A3 (rare for a REIT), net debt/EBITDA 5.0x vs peers 6-7x, 93.8% fixed at 4.05% / 6.5yr, occupancy 95.7% -> 97.5% runway, RE-FFO +7.5% w/ raised guide
the_decisive_tax_math: REIT dividend = ordinary income; CA does NOT conform to 199A -> ~46.7% all-in on the coupon: 3.9% headline = ~2.1% NET. Our in-state CA muni book pays ~3.7% NET at high-grade-GO risk — SPG's carry is DOMINATED by what we already own. The residual case is a tax-deferred total-return compounder (~5-7% after-tax at a flat multiple) — fully priced at 16.9x P/FFO (high end of the post-COVID range), +22% YTD, 2% off the ATH, crowded.
dividend_record: cut ~38% in COVID, restored past peak by 2023-24, now +7%/yr at a 68% RE-FFO payout — real cushion for a garden recession, but the record proves it cuts in a severe one: NOT bond-like carry
bear_2027: consumer recession -> spreads compress w/ 2-3yr lease lag -> RE-FFO flat-to--5%, multiple to ~14x -> $175-185 (-17-21%) — recoverable, not impairment
account_type_caveat: would be a legitimate A-rated total-return hold in an IRA/401k or lower bracket — the CA ordinary-income drag is the entire disqualifier
insider_cluster: 5 directors ~$400k late-June — pointer-grade only (drift NULL), noted not weighted

edge_explainer.market_believes: The A-mall king executed the retail apocalypse in reverse — occupancy at records, guidance raised, own the quality.
edge_explainer.we_believe: All true and all owned: 16.9x at 2% off the all-time high IS the recovery, priced. The honest offer is ~9% pre-tax total return — which our tax situation converts to ~5-7%, below what our existing muni carry + equity edges offer at less risk.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: None — the finding. True-but-priced, the SRPT quadrant.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Nothing pending — re-look on a real dislocation (a consumer-recession de-rate toward 14x/~$180 makes the total-return math interesting even after tax).
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: If SPG ever retires a KPI the way Macerich retired its spread metric, the sector theme itself is over — that tripwire lives in the malls theme file.
